pages.text: The Create Jetpack is a backtank you can fly with. It is built around a Copper Backtank and spends pressurised air to lift you, so it runs dry and needs refilling.

pages.title: Jetpack
pages.text: Jump rises, sneak descends, G switches the engine on or off, H toggles hover mode. Keys can be changed in Controls.

pages.title: Netherite Jetpack
pages.text: The same flight, built around a Netherite Backtank. Check JEI for the upgrade recipe.

Both versions are crafted by mechanical crafting from an Elytra, Chutes, Brass plates, Precision Mechanisms and the backtank. Press R over one in JEI to see the layout.$(br2)For something larger than one person, see $(l:flight/airships)Airships$(/l).
